Takeoffs & landings runway used for each operation

EventTimeAirportRunwayTrack
Runway is inferred from the GPS ground track through each liftoff / touchdown, matched to the airport's runway headings (true). A strong crosswind can occasionally bias the match by a few degrees.

Alerts & annunciations crew-alerting (CAS) and terrain / TAWS messages

MessageSeconds active
Persistent advisories such as GEAR DOWN (fixed-gear) or start-up NO COMP flags during AHRS alignment are normal ground/boot artifacts, not in-flight faults.
